description: This file defines classes, enums, and functions for handling bounds and overlap analysis in tensor expressions, including the Bound class, OverlapKind enum, and related utility functions.

classes.name: Bound
classes.description: Represents a range in a single dimension with start and end expressions, and a swapped flag.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two Bound objects are equal.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps start and end expressions and toggles the swapped flag.
